items.title: Banks report third-party AI agents logging into customer accounts with shared passwords
items.summary: Large U.S. banks are reportedly seeing third-party AI agents sign into customer accounts with the customer's own username and password, which makes it hard to tell person from agent. Some banks are blocking that access and updating their terms, though not every bank confirmed the reports.

items.title: Report: criminal group ran a swarm of AI agents against 400+ Latin American banks
items.summary: Security firm Straiker reported that a criminal group built an automated system of AI agents, using several commercial models, to attack more than 400 Latin American financial institutions. Anthropic cut off the group's access and an investigation is under way.

items.title: PhoneUse launches real and cloud phones that AI agents can tap and swipe through
items.summary: PhoneUse launched a service that gives AI agents cloud Android phones or real iPhones and Androids to tap and swipe through apps that have no API. It is aimed at handling things like push notifications, two-factor codes and device checks.

items.title: Walmart opens Agent Gateway, an MCP server that lets approved AI agents shop for customers
items.summary: Walmart launched Agent Gateway, an MCP server that lets approved AI agents check stock and place orders at Walmart and Sam's Club. Agent Profiles coming next month will keep agent orders separate, require purchase approval by default and allow optional spending limits.

items.title: Breken launches an AI tester that rebuilds and stress-tests apps before release
items.summary: Breken launched an AI testing tool that recreates an app's production setup, speeds up simulated usage and injects failures to find bugs before users do. In its own test it caught about a third of 235 known open-source bugs.

items.title: Anthropic previews Claude Duet, a proactive agent app that watches your email and calendar
items.summary: Anthropic opened a research preview of Claude Duet, a standalone app that checks connected apps like email, Slack and calendar, sends a morning brief and works on tasks in its own cloud computer. It asks for approval before key actions and is on a waitlist for U.S. Pro and Max subscribers.

items.title: Ex-Apple Watch lead launches Niq, an AI agent that helps manage migraines
items.summary: Former Apple Watch product lead Praneeta Pujari launched Niq, an iOS agent from her startup UniqueHuman that uses wearable data, records and check-ins to anticipate migraine flare-ups. It also helps with appointments, prescriptions and insurance, with doctors overseeing decisions.

items.title: Beacon, an open-source memory layer, carries coding context across 20+ AI agents
items.summary: Asymptote Labs released Beacon, an open-source tool that records coding sessions from more than 20 AI agents and turns them into reusable skills, so developers can switch tools without re-explaining their project. It runs locally by default and arrived with a $5.5 million seed round.
